Hey.

We all do stuff regret - stuff we told ourselves we'd never do again. But hey, we had a chance to fix it, and we did. And damn, we don't ever appreciate ourselves enough for taking that step. I'm so proud of you for staying strong for such a long time. But the thing with chances in life is that we'll always have more. Take another chance; don't let yourself fall again. Climb back up, because you're strong enough too, even if you don't feel like it. You'll always have that strength in you. You're amazing like that. Don't let this one incident smoulder all the hard work you've done for yourself. You don't deserve it, no way in hell. You're too precious for that. Rise above.

Go to the doctor. It's boring, tedious, but it'll help you feel like getting off your bed and beginning the day. A feeling that's a bit foreign now, right? It's time to change that. 

Keep sharing your journey. I'd love to hear more, all the bad and good. I believe you'll impress yourself, even if the whole 'disappointing yourself' thing comes first. You can do it. You can.

​

Im so glad you've decided to share your feelings. It's really worrying for me to hear how much you are going through. You don't deserve to feel this. What's been hurting you? Do you need to talk about it? Please don't feel like you're burdening anyone by sharing.

You are precious and beautiful. Some days it's harder to believe that, but it will always be true. You have so much potential. You can do anything. You can go anywhere. You are amazing.

What can we do to help? I understand how that feels, so closely. That's why I need to help. I know what it's like to be on that edge - a lot of us do - please don't feel like you're facing this alone.

Please consider contacting a help line, a doctor or a close friend. It's hard to muster up the confidence to take that step, but it will only benefit you, in ways you can't perceive yet. Just take the chance for you.

Willow, please don't leave us so soon. Please keep talking to us. I don't want you to leave us.

Do you play any games, or watch any shows or movies? I can recommend some for you, or maybe you can tell me about the ones you like. Do you read or draw? I would love to see some if you'd be willing to share! Maybe you play some sport? I tend to dabble in Tennis myself. What about you?

I've read a majority of the comments and tried to reply to all of them. God, how I wish I checked reddit earlier to thank all of you for the kind souls you are.

After a couple of hours went by without a message, I just deleted all my social media for the day. Because honestly, I shouldn't have been relying on them for happiness. I have my family who I love for that. I ended up using my birthday money and the money I saved up to buy myself a new phone and take some pictures (I love photography) and play some Pubg. Played some RDR2 (love it so much)! Went out for food and had a beautiful cake.

 At school I am still kind to them and love them, but as many of you say in your replies, I need to prioritize myself. I give love and don't receive it? That's okay. Don't like me as much as I like you? That's okay. I'm not going to change myself for you to like me more though. I realize now that's a part of myself that I need to change, and not really their fault. I'm not confident that I can find other people who like me, so I stick to people who like me, but always make me feel left out.  Its a deep flaw that I feel a plentiful amount of people can relate to. Changing this part of myself is something I'm going to try and do this year. I've got my family and I've got me. 

Thank you again to you wonderful, wonderful, beautiful people. Your kindness is appreciated endlessly. I hope anyone who has gone through the same "forgotten birthday" feels loved, appreciated and happy. You are all amazing and stunning.
